hero.eyebrow: A digital team based in Baku
hero.h1: Digital systems that work for your business.
hero.lead: We build web, marketing and brand as one connected system focused on the same business goal.

band.label: Our approach
band.h3: Then we plan and deliver around your business.
band.p: We do not sell a fixed package. We set priorities around your goals, team and budget, then divide the work into clear stages.

workbench.label: The workbench
workbench.heading: We turn ideas into working products.
workbench.text: We consider four disciplines together, so design, technology and growth never drift apart.
workbench.p1: We clarify in one sentence why people should choose you.
workbench.p2: Not just attractive screens, but a consistent language people recognize across channels.
workbench.p3: We connect fast, mobile-friendly websites to the real way your business works.
workbench.p4: After launch, we learn from data, test ideas and keep improving.

process.label: How we work
process.heading: From first conversation to launch.
process.text: At every stage, you know what we are doing, why it matters and what comes next.
process.p1: Together, we define your business, audience and the clearest opportunities for growth.
process.p2: We turn strategy into a fast, distinctive digital experience built to convert.
process.p3: We track performance, learn from real data and keep improving the system.

toolkit.label: Capabilities, not tools
toolkit.heading: The team the work requires.
toolkit.text: We bring the right disciplines together for the project, so you do not have to coordinate separate suppliers.

principles.label: Working principles
principles.heading: The process matters as much as the result.
principles.p1: We do not hide behind technical language. Decisions and their reasons stay visible.
principles.p2: You see real progress, give feedback and help set priorities throughout the project.
principles.p3: Launch is not the finish line. We review results and plan the next useful step.

faq.label: Frequently asked
faq.a1: The first conversation clarifies goals, audience, current problems and the budget range. We then share a phased plan.
faq.q2: Can we hire you for one service?
faq.a2: Yes. We can complement your existing team and focus only on web, advertising, design or SEO.
faq.a3: Pricing depends on scope, timing and the team required. Every stage is shown separately in the proposal.
faq.q4: Do you support the site after launch?
faq.a4: Yes. Ongoing technical support, analytics, optimization and new feature work are available.

stats.label: Formula
stats.statement: One team. One heartbeat. Zero excuses.

testimonials.label: Clients say
testimonials.q1: They understood us faster than any agency we've worked with.
testimonials.q2: They deliver three weeks ahead of every estimate.

cta.p: We will listen to what you need and define a sensible approach and next steps together.

footer.tagline: A Baku-based 360° digital agency. Strategy, design, development and marketing from one team.

services.lead: From strategy to delivery — every stage of your digital presence from one team.

about.storyP2: Every project starts from the real business goal: what you want to change, for whom, and how we will measure it.

svcDetail.s2p: A clear plan and measurable KPIs.

veb-saytlar.title: Web & E-commerce
veb-saytlar.short: Fast, conversion-focused websites and online stores.
veb-saytlar.o1: We build fast, search-ready websites that reflect your brand — from landing pages to corporate sites, from WooCommerce stores to custom solutions.
veb-saytlar.o2: Every project ships with Core Web Vitals in mind, mobile-first design and a manageable content structure.

seo.title: SEO & Technical SEO
seo.short: Keywords, technical audit and content strategy for organic traffic.
seo.o1: We grow your search visibility measurably: technical audit, keyword research, on-page optimisation and quality content.
seo.o2: We report progress every month using Search Console and analytics.

reklam.title: Google & Meta Ads
reklam.short: ROAS-focused performance ads: Google, Meta, TikTok.
reklam.o1: We build and manage campaigns to get the most out of your budget: audiences, creatives, A/B tests and continuous optimisation.
reklam.o2: Transparent reporting shows where every manat goes.

brendinq.title: Branding & Design
brendinq.short: Logo, visual identity and UI/UX — memorable brands.
brendinq.o1: We turn your brand’s character into a visual language: logo, colour, typography, brand book and digital product design.
brendinq.o2: A consistent, modern identity that works on every platform.

smm.title: SMM & Social Media
smm.short: Content plan, community management and growth strategy.
smm.o1: We run your social accounts with a strategy: content calendar, shoots, design, copywriting and community management.
smm.o2: Organic growth with Reels and short-form video.

ai-avtomatlasdirma.title: AI & Automation
ai-avtomatlasdirma.short: CRM, lead flow and business process automation.
ai-avtomatlasdirma.o1: We automate repetitive work and speed up your customer flow with AI: chatbots, lead scoring, CRM integrations and email automation.
ai-avtomatlasdirma.o2: Your team focuses on strategy, the system handles the rest.
